experiment: parameter-scope x capacity ablation for M1 I2N binding
protocol: M1-only (image->alias), N=10 identities, 1000 optimizer steps, LR 2e-5, batch 1 x grad_accum 8, seed 17, 10/3/3 splits, identical prompts and evaluation

architecture_finding.finding: Language tower is hybrid: 32 decoder layers, of which only layers {3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31} are full_attention (config layer_types); the other 24 are linear_attention and expose no q/k/v/o_proj. 'language_attention_only' therefore covers 32 modules (8 layers x 4 projections), not 128.
architecture_finding.consequence: All language-attention runs in this study had identical full attention coverage; the earlier 'stride-4' interpretation was an artifact of this architecture, not a reduced scope. Profile fields num_language_layers=32 and lora_expected_target_modules=128 are incorrect for this revision.

results_test_split.scope: merger + language attention + late visual blocks 22-26 (54 modules)

comparisons.capacity_control: S0-R16 vs S0: doubling rank (alpha/r held constant) changes nothing (test 0.133 vs 0.167, within noise). Binding failure is NOT rank-capacity-limited.
comparisons.cross_modal_access: S1 vs S0: merger-only reaches the highest train fit (0.64) and best candidate ranking (0.367) but zero generalization (val 0.233, test 0.167) - memorization of image-specific features, not identity binding.
comparisons.access_plus_readout: S2 vs S0: adding trainable merger to language attention provides no benefit (test 0.10-0.13 vs 0.167); S2-repro confirms within noise.
comparisons.late_visual: S3 vs S2: adding trainable late visual blocks provides no benefit (test 0.167).

verdict: No scope x capacity combination approaches the pre-registered gate I2N >= 0.90; full mediated-condition testing is not triggered. Combined with (a) frozen-embedding 1-NN separability = 1.0, (b) the N=2->4 capacity cliff, (c) identical plateau across all scopes/ranks: the failure is an interference phenomenon in binding acquisition at >= 4 identities, invariant to parameter scope (within LoRA) and rank capacity at this step budget.
remaining_candidate_mechanisms: The 24 linear-attention language layers were never trainable in any run; linear-layer adaptation is untested.
Token-level prior analysis (pending): test whether low loss reflects a learned alias prior P(alias-like|X) rather than P(alias_i|x_i).
Optimizer/step-budget interaction with interference (curriculum, per-identity staging).
